comparison.objective: Zero a dial indicator at its current reading without disturbing its setup.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine rotational adjustment while isolating the mounted instrument from disturbance.
comparison.success_condition: Indicator zeroed with the setup undisturbed; numeric tolerances and scoring details are absent.
comparison.reason: Calibration adjustment is meaningfully different from bimanual hammer-and-mandrel fracture and physical fragment containment.
